jobIds.title: Job IDs
jobIds.description: job_id values from any factpipe jobs Actor (Jobs Feed API, Bulk Job Postings Feed, Workday/Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby Jobs API...), e.g. "greenhouse:gitlab:8396674002" or "workday:redhat.wd5/jobs:R-043519". Up to 200,000 per run.

jobUrls.title: Job URLs
jobUrls.description: Job page or apply links (job_url / apply_url) on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, Workday, Personio or Teamtailor, e.g. "https://jobs.lever.co/acme/<id>" or "https://acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/External/job/Berlin/Engineer_R123". A company careers-page URL works when an indexed job uses it (e.g. Greenhouse ?gh_jid= links).
